observations: A wooden double bunk bed frame with a reddish-brown finish.

The top bunk includes a safety guard rail on the visible side.
The bed is positioned outdoors on a concrete or paved surface.
A watermark 'DIVINE GRACE FURNITURE' is visible across the center of the image.
The construction appears to be local carpentry using either solid wood or wood-veneer boards.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows a complete double bunk bed structure.

risks.if_unproven: priced as unstable and requiring additional reinforcement.

risks.risk: The mattresses shown may not be included in the sale or may be in poor hygienic condition.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the mattresses without covers and explicit confirmation of their inclusion.
risks.if_unproven: priced as the bed frame only, without mattresses.

risks.risk: Material quality may be low-grade particle board or MDF rather than solid wood, affecting durability.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of an unfinished edge or a joint showing the internal material grain.
risks.if_unproven: priced as being made of MDF or particle board.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged assembly hardware such as bolts or screws.
risks.proof: A photo of the disassembled joints and the complete set of hardware.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having missing or stripped hardware.

Close-up photos of the mattresses without covers.
Close-up photos of the joints and assembly hardware.
Confirmation of the material (solid wood vs. MDF).
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a wooden double bunk bed. It can be priced based on its visible type, assuming the worst-case scenario for stability, material quality, and mattress inclusion.
